programme.desc:
John Michael Chambers hosts this special broadcast with Susan Kokinda Vice Chair of the Michigan Republican Party and founder of Promethean Action for an in-depth discussion on President Trumps economic and strategic revolution and the critical November 3rd midterm elections
Susan explains that Trump is bringing back the American System of Political Economy — the founding fathers unique economic model based on the productive powers of the human mind not financial speculation She reveals how the British Empire subverted Americas economic independence through the Federal Reserve and the assassination of William McKinley and how Trump is now dismantling that imperial model The administrations tariff policy focus on science and technology and creation of parallel institutions like the Office of Strategic Capital and Export-Import Bank are all pillars of this revolution while Kevin Warsh is clipping the wings of the Federal Reserve by ending forward guidance and shrinking its interventionist footprint
